newsitem.title: UK: Venezuela tells OPEC it slightly over quota in Dec.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela tells OPEC it slightly over quota in Dec.

text.p: Venezuela told OPEC it produced over its individual quota in December, the OPEC News Agency reported.
But the official figures it provided to the Vienna-based Secretariat were far below the estimates given by most analysts and others monitoring OPEC production.

Venezuela, usually seen by analysts and some other OPEC members as OPEC's biggest quota violator, told OPEC it produced 2,391 million barrels per day (bpd), compared to its OPEC quota of 2.359 million bpd.
It said it supplied to the market 2,381 million bpd.

OPEC sets its quotas according to supply to the market and not by wellhead production. Supply, as defined by OPEC, is calculated as domestic consumption, plus net export sales of crude and products, plus withdrawals of stocks held outside national boundaries.
Most OPEC member countries tell OPEC they produce within their quotas but independent surveys show most of the 11-member group over quota.
